newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE FANS PARTY ALL NIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE FANS PARTY ALL NIGHT.

text.p: Thousands of Schalke fans in the club's home town of Gelsenkirchen, in Germany's Ruhr Valley industrial heartland, celebrated throughout the night after their team's UEFA Cup win.
More than 30,000 of them watched the match on a giant video screen at the team's Park Stadium. Streets were almost deserted as Schalke beat favourites Internazionale 4-1 in a penalty shoot-out.
It was the first European trophy in Schalke's 93-year history and their first title of any kind in 25 years.
After partying all night fans went to the local airport to meet the team who landed at 7 a.m. (0500 GMT).
"We only had about a half-hour's sleep," said Schalke captain Olaf Thon. "We still can't believe this is real."
